about: What an app does at start with a database whose migration steps are not the ones it was made with (docs/ledger/migrations.md, Design): it does not migrate, it checks. With `had` steps of the `steps` it was made with, it is behind or ahead, and stops with `line` on the console, in English (not from the translations), exiting with 1; with as many it opens (`line` null). `source` names the database's data source. Every runtime's check gives the same line.
